name: DPIH
recent: DPIH 近期宣布以 RM7.6m 收购沙巴工业用地，并向子公司提供总额 RM8.5m 的财务援助。公司也发布了季度业绩、年度报告，此外，两名主要管理人员出现变动。
notable: 子公司 Eastern Forever (Sabah) 以 RM7.6m 收购沙巴 KKIP 工业用地。
公司向子公司 Eastern Forever 和 Eastern Forever (Sabah) 提供总额 RM8.5m 的财务援助。
risks: 收购土地需满足先决条件，包括取得开发商同意及解除现有抵押，完成可能延迟。
收购资金可能来自银行借款，利率上升或信贷收紧将增加借贷成本。
若延迟取得融资，可能产生年利率 8.0% 的利息费用或违约后果。

news.title: DPI Holdings to buy Sabah industrial land for RM7.6m

recent_en: DPIH recently announced the acquisition of Sabah industrial land for RM7.6m and the provision of RM8.5m financial assistance to subsidiaries. The company also released quarterly results, an annual report, and proposed a first interim dividend. Additionally, two principal officers changed.
notable_en: Subsidiary Eastern Forever (Sabah) acquired industrial land in KKIP, Sabah for RM7.6m.
The company provided RM8.5m financial assistance to subsidiaries Eastern Forever and Eastern Forever (Sabah).
Proposed a first interim dividend of 0.10 sen per share.
risks_en: The land acquisition is subject to conditions precedent, including developer consent and discharge of existing charge, and completion may be delayed.
The acquisition may be funded by bank borrowings; rising interest rates or tighter credit could increase borrowing costs.
Delay in securing financing may incur interest charges at 8.0% per annum or default consequences.
